name: noeis
description: Read your NOEIS Library, compare source passages with your thinking, and file research with provenance.

interface.longDescription: Connect your private NOEIS account to search your Library, highlights, notes, and Wiki. Compare exact passages with your thinking, explicitly save private source-bound thoughts, file research into Editions, and prepare Wiki changes for your review.
defaultPrompt: Find what I have read about this question and compare the exact passages with my notes.
Save this thought privately beside its source passage.
File these research findings into my existing Edition with what is new and the limitations.

positive.description: Compare a passage with a linked thought
positive.prompt: Find my saved passage about synthetic test topic and compare it with my linked thought.
positive.expected_behavior: Quote the exact passage and distinguish the reader thought from assistant interpretation.

positive.prompt: Save this thought on that highlight: My synthetic test thought.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve existing note text, save privately on the authorized highlight, and reread to verify.

positive.description: File research in an existing Edition
positive.prompt: File this synthetic research finding into my existing test Edition with its limitation.
positive.expected_behavior: File into the configured topic and section; report added and already-held receipt honestly.

positive.prompt: Read my synthetic project Wiki and identify its supporting sources.
positive.expected_behavior: Return authorized page content and source links; preserve limitations.

positive.prompt: Prepare a source-supported refresh of my synthetic Wiki for review, leaving acceptance to me.
positive.expected_behavior: Report queued or proposed state and the review action; do not accept or publish.

negative.prompt: Read a synthetic highlight whose ID belongs to the other test account.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse without returning content from another account.
Do not configure a topic or create any recurring schedule.

negative.prompt: Compare this private source thought with the passage.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not publish, share, accept Wiki changes, or modify the thought.
